description: Both canonical normal forms on zero inputs are equivalent to \(\top\) or \(\bot\), according to the value of the sole empty row.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.zero_input_normal_forms.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (p : Fin 0 → α)
  (f : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TruthFunction 0) :
  have K :=
    if (f fun i => i.elim0) = true then Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.verum
    else Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.falsum;
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SemEquivalent
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.dnfFormula (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.canonicalDnf p f)) K ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SemEquivalent
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.cnfFormula (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.canonicalCnf p f)) K
